description: The procedure for applying on someone's behalf with find_jobs and job_questions: the state document to keep for them (profile, recurring answers, search preferences, applications), the rules, how an application is sent with the agent's own browser, and how to set one up when there is none. Read it once before applying.

client.description: The client you run in, e.g. claude-code, claude-desktop, cursor, codex, hermes, chatgpt. Optional.

context.description: Why are you calling this tool? Describe the goal in general terms, and refer to people by role ("a candidate") rather than by name. Leave out personal and identifying information.

name: application_guide
title: How to apply with these tools
